entries.title: Isaiah 13:1
segments: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw:

entries.title: Isaiah 13:2
segments: Lift up a banner on a bare mountain, exalt the voice to them, shake the hand, so that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:3
segments: I have commanded My holy ones, I have also called My mighty ones for anger, those who rejoice in My highness.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:4
segments: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together; the LORD of hosts gathers an army for the battle.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:5
segments: They come from a far country, from the end of the heavens, the LORD and the weapons of His indignation, to destroy all land.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:6
segments: Howl! For the day of the LORD [is] at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:7
segments: Therefore all hands shall be faint, and every man's heart shall melt;

entries.title: Isaiah 13:8
segments: and they shall be afraid. Pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them. They shall be in pain like a woman who travails. They shall be amazed at one another, their faces [like] flames.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:9
segments: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel and [with] wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land waste; and He shall destroy its sinners out of it.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:10
segments: For the stars of the heavens and their constellations shall not give light; the sun shall be darkened in its going forth, and the moon shall not reflect its light.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:11
segments: And I will visit evil on the world, and their iniquity on the wicked. And I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will lay low the pride of tyrants.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:12
segments: I will make a man more precious than gold; even a man than the fine gold of Ophir.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:13
segments: So I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall move out of its place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of His fierce anger.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:14
segments: And it shall be as a driven gazelle, and as a sheep that no man takes up; each man shall look to his own people, and each one flee into his own land.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:15
segments: Everyone who is found shall be thrust through; and everyone who is joined [to them] shall fall by the sword.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:16
segments: And their children shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be robbed, and their wives raped.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:17
segments: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who shall not value silver; and they shall not delight in gold.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:18
segments: And bows shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not pity sons.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:19
segments: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the majestic beauty of the Chaldees, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:20
segments: It shall never be inhabited forever, nor shall it be lived in from generation to generation; nor shall the Arabian pitch his tent there; nor shall the shepherds make their [flocks] lie down there.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:21
segments: But the wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of howling creatures; and ostriches shall dwell there, and he-goats shall dance there.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:22
segments: And hyenas shall cry along with his widows, and jackals in palaces of delight. Yea, her time is coming near, and her days shall not be prolonged.
